source.label: FY2024 Form 10-K, Item 5
source.quote: As of April 11, 2025, there were approximately 129 stockholders of record of our Class A common stock and seven stockholders of record of our Class B common stock.

notes: NBIM: NBIM's year-end 2024 equity list has no line for Rent the Runway. CalPERS: its Form 13F for the quarter ended December 31, 2024 lists no shares or ADRs of Rent the Runway. Holders of record: Listed Class A only; the 10-K also gives seven holders of record of Class B.
